name: Spiko EU T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: EUTBL is Spiko's AMF-authorized UCITS short-term VNAV money-market fund backed by Eurozone sovereign T-bills, tokenized for KYC-gated investors.
collateral: Short-dated Eurozone sovereign Treasury bills (issued by AAA / strong-Member-State issuers) with weighted average maturity under two months, held by a UCITS-compliant short-term money market fund administered under Spiko's AMF authorization
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share token (ISIN FR001400ODL1) of the Spiko SICAV short-term VNAV money market sub-fund authorised by the AMF, backed primarily by French and German Eurozone sovereign T-bills (and other top-rated Member-State issuers such as the Netherlands) with a regulatory weighted-average maturity ceiling under 60 days; subscription and redemption are KYC-gated to allowlisted wallets through Spiko's transfer agent with a daily 11:30 Paris cutoff settling at the day's published NAV (T+0 / next-business-day for late orders) and a €1k minimum; cross-chain issuance on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon is relayed through Chainlink CCIP. Prospectus: https://cdn.spiko.finance/legal_docs/EN/Prospectus_Spiko_SICAV_EN.pdf

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: EUTBL is an NAV-accreting, regulated Spiko SICAV money-market fund share backed by a short-term Eurozone sovereign bill mandate. The prospectus and KID support the T-bill fund classification, daily dealing, and eligible-instrument maturity limits. They do not establish a current security-level allocation, complete holder seniority and loss-recovery design, or all chain-specific implementation controls.

Token proxy admin slot = zero. Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, Etherlink, Stellar, and Starknet routes remain unresolved.

reserveReview.rationale: The producer emits one 100% NAV identity for the regulated Spiko EU T-Bills Money Market Fund. The KID and prospectus establish daily dealing, an explicit 180-day maximum residual maturity for eligible instruments, and a short-term Eurozone-government mandate. The prior 95/5 Treasury-bill and cash split was not a reported live allocation, so this review classifies the exact producer identity at the fund-share level.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact Chainlink NAV single-asset identity cross-checked against Spiko's current product page, prospectus, and KID
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No exposure outside the emitted fund NAV identity is indicated. Current security weights and operational settlement cash inside the regulated fund are not published by the NAV producer and are intentionally not represented as separate authored slices.
